chunk_map.heading: The outcome at the root makes the merge choose

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: chunk 0 line 4: "merge your opportunity trees" is the closest; the preceding slide in the lecture include order (apt101-widen-before-you-choose.md: the-branch-one-of-you-found, line 4 'Merge everyone's opportunity trees') names the trees; 'it' = the agent named in the same sentence; 'the outcome you agreed on' is anchored by the header and line 6 'the outcome at the root of the tree'.
no pointer to another file or position in the body (lines 4-8); 'what most of you saw' (line 4) points at the room's own trees, not a file.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.evidence: closest: line 4 'what most of you saw' is a recognised effect stated in the preceding slide, not a 'the X you did' beat; grep for 'you (did|saw|caught)' in body returns only that phrase.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no guess-before-reveal beat or demo scene; every sentence is verbed (lines 4,6,8)

rules_evaluated.evidence: line 4-8: three paragraphs carry a full claim (frameless merge drifts; outcome makes each branch answer to it); stands alone.
header 'The outcome at the root makes the merge choose' is true of line 6 'does this move the outcome ... dropped by name'; no contradiction.

closest: line 8 'The variety comes from each of you. The choice comes from the outcome you agreed on.' is a two-leg parallel pair, not a triple, not 'Not X. Not Y. Z.'; no superlatives, no number+retraction, no verb triplet.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: closest: line 6 'opportunity trees' / 'branch' / 'root' are Torres product vocabulary the room uses, not repo dialect; no beat/mood/compendium/surface-as-noun in body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: grep -c '\*\*' on body lines 1-9 -> 0 bold elements

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Presence precedes content — verify against the composed deck, not long-read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: grep -rl 'slides/the-outcome-makes-it-pick.md' curriculum/lectures -> lectures/apt101-widen-before-you-choose.md line 11, a standalone include line, so the slide is inlined into the deck.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Numbering — position is computed, content ordinals are linted.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Slide size — 210 words / 6 bullets, and the cap is machine-checked.
Heading grammar is the mood switch, and it is load-bearing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: lecture slide; header 'The outcome at the root makes the merge choose' is a claim, as required for a lecture heading

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A bullet earns its slot or dies — three classes that read as rigour and carry nothing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: closest: line 8 'The variety comes from each of you. The choice comes from the outcome you agreed on.' could read as an aphorism kicker (c), but it adds the division of labour (variety from people, choice from outcome) that the header and lines 4-6 do not state; carried deliberately per the maintainer block. No doctrine restatement or design commentary.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A retitled slide re-earns its bullets against the new header.
rules_evaluated.evidence: git log -p on the file shows the header added once in 4f50a398-era creation, never changed above unchanged bullets; the body answers the current header (line 6).
